newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia closes faulty reactor at chemical plant.
newsitem.headline: Russia closes faulty reactor at chemical plant.

text.p: Russian authorities have closed a faulty nuclear reactor at a Siberian chemical plant, forcing the cities of Tomsk and Seversk to switch to emergency heating systems, Russian news agencies said on Saturday.
Itar-Tass agency said there had been no leak of radiation into the plant or to the surrounding area and the reactor would be switched on again on Sunday.
"The malfunction ranked zero on the scale of nuclear incidents," the agency said. Zero refers to a minor incident with no impact on safety at the reactor or around it.
NTV television said water had seeped into a faulty fuel rod at the reactor and reacted with uranium. A second reactor at the chemical plant was closed for routine maintanance earlier this month.
